svg.title: TOPAK D1 — The admit path: decide, then order, then effect
svg.desc: Every effect an agent causes passes eight steps on one replica of the reference mechanism. Steps 1–6 decide against one state snapshot; step 7 orders the admit in the Paxos log and re-checks it at its log position; step 8 performs the effect, only after commit. Denials leave at every step and are recorded but never ordered. admit ⟺ floor_permit ∧ ¬bundle_deny (ADR-0030 §1).
svg.text: TOPAK · D1

text.tspan: The admit path: decide, then order, then effect

svg.text: Every effect an agent causes passes eight steps on one replica of the reference mechanism. Steps 1–6 decide against one state snapshot; step 7 orders the admit in the Paxos log and re-checks it at its log position; step 8 performs the effect, only after commit. Denials leave at every step and are recorded but never ordered. admit ⟺ floor_permit ∧ ¬bundle_deny (ADR-0030 §1).

text.tspan: Built at reference · evidence · rung 0 as deployed

svg.text: The bearer token on the replica's agent socket names the seat, the lease (its fence, a log index) and the epoch; every action carries all three (ADR-0022 §2).
A launched guest has no token: at rung 1 the launcher's bridge is its session; under an attested session key each action carries the guest's session proof, checked
here against the action (I14, I41; ADR-0033 A7, pending).
SubmitWorkspace becomes Submit(digest) over the round workspace; an abstain from a Run seat is refused here, before ordering (ADR-0042 §5).
Names no principal and no round, so there is no round record for it: an authentication event
logged at this replica's socket (ADR-0003 A2 note; register G5).
deny
The lease TTL runs on this replica's monotonic clock from when it applied the grant, read with the asymmetric margin, so it elapses early (ADR-0032 §2). No local
observation of the grant counts as expired: fail closed.
A liveness check only. The fence in step 3 carries safety.
The replica also proposes EndRound(Expired): a subtraction, ordered so replicas agree, approved
by nobody (ADR-0033 §4; ADR-0031 E1).
deny

text.tspan: Mechanism checks: epoch fence, lease, alphabet

svg.text: check_live, in order: the lease is known and is this seat's; lease epoch = current epoch (the fence); request epoch = lease epoch; lease rules epoch = current rules
epoch; lease not ended; action in the lease's alphabet; round bound not reached; action preconditions (Submit once; Vote only on a submitted artifact whose gates
passed).
Then channel fidelity: under an attested lease whose Run profile says P4 passes, an Actuate naming a tool not hosted as Wasm is refused (channel_fidelity;
ADR-0034 A2, ADR-0033 A8, both pending).
Mechanism, not policy: the floor never decides whether an epoch is current (ADR-0030 §4).
FencedEpoch, RequestEpochMismatch, FencedRulesEpoch, LeaseEnded, NotInAlphabet,
RoundBoundReached, ArtifactNotSubmitted, ArtifactAlreadySubmitted, GatesNotPassed,
EvidenceMismatch, AlreadyPromoted; Other, for a Run tool not held to its channel.
deny
Mechanical and total: every fact is a set membership, an equality or a path-syntax check; nothing interprets meaning (ADR-0007, ADR-0018 validator side).
Principal, action, resource, context and the complete entity slice in schema S's shape, plus the bundle's view built from the same facts. Resolved once; the bundle
may not re-fetch (ADR-0030 §4). Its digest goes into the admit.
observerLive is live(o), computed here (ADR-0039 §1).
A request the lift cannot build (for Submit, an artifact that is not the workspace digest) is a
mechanism deny.
deny
floor/genesis-floor.cedar, schema S and the values file compiled in by path; the replica refuses to start unless their bytes match the gated digests (ADR-0033
§2). The floor text is DRAFT, not ratified.
S is enforced on every request: a non-conforming input is a deny (ADR-0030 §4).
Floor([forbids that fired]), or FloorNoPermit: outside every envelope (finding 10).
FloorError: any evaluation error is a deny, since Cedar skips an erroring forbid (ADR-0030 §1).
The bundle is never consulted.
deny

text.tspan: Bundle: OPA sidecar | WASM · can only refuse

svg.text: data.topak.bundle.allow, counted only from the revision the lease names, and only if that revision's signature verified under the rules' bundle_keys (ADR-0044;
built, ADR-0033 A6).
Sidecar unreachable or serving another revision → the in-process WASM engine decides iff it holds that revision; otherwise refuse. Every admit records which engine
decided.
Deny, error, undefined, absent or unreachable: anything but an affirmative true refuses. A bundle
is never asked whether to grant (ADR-0030 §1).
deny

text.tspan: Decide · the deciding replica, against one state snapshot (B2 membrane)

svg.text: floor permit ∧ bundle allow
Deciding and ordering are separated in time (ADR-0033 §4; ADR-0015 E1). The admit carries its decision, and the floor and bundle are not re-run at apply; the
mechanism state is.
Re-proposed under one id every 750 ms, up to
a 5 s deadline; the state machine applies an id
at most once.
Crash-recovery Multi-Paxos over 3 replicas;
promises and votes fsynced to the WAL before
any reply leaves (ADR-0033 §3).
check_live again at the log position; the
parameter digest; for Actuate/Report under a
Thinker, the deterministic half of live(o);
channel fidelity; under a session key, the
guest's proof with a fresh counter.
Fails the re-check (fenced between decision and commit; decided under other parameters; no cell Observer covers the seat at commit; a Run tool not held to its channel;
a session proof that is not the attested guest's, or a replayed counter): ordered, recorded, without effect. Returned as NotCommitted, and so recorded as a denial too.
re-check fails
The admit was voided at apply, or not committed before the 5 s deadline.
Ordering is not authorization: a void admit is in the log, and a denial still is not.
deny

text.tspan: Order · the Paxos log (P), the ordering authority
Effect: after commit, on the deciding replica only

svg.text: A crash between commit and effect leaves an admit with no effect, which is safe: absence of effect is not an event (ADR-0015). Effects are exactly {tool invocation,
principal emission}.
Bytes from the content-addressed corpus store, checked against their
address. Consult is ingress, no effect (ADR-0040).
Write into the round-scoped workspace ws-<seat>-e<epoch>-r<round>, on
the deciding replica only (workspaces are not replicated, register G9).
A native tool: the tool host spawns name@digest, checks binary and schema
digests, cleared environment, workspace as cwd. Hermeticity is not checked
(G4), nor a native Run tool's channel (G19).
A tool the node hosts as Wasm runs as a module whose one network
capability is its declared target (I44; A8, pending). Dev hosts none.
Actuate leaves a mechanism-written record (ADR-0042 §3): returned,
failed, or unknown if the round sealed first.
Written only after commit, carrying the admit's log index, the lease fence
and the per-lease sequence number (ToO §4.2).
Topic topak.<chain>.<domain>.<seat>.e<epoch>.r<round> (ADR-0003
A1). Submit and Vote have no outside effect: the admit is the record (F3 for
a vote).

text.tspan: Effect · reaches the world only as an admit (B3 typed effect)
Denials are not ordered, and they are recorded

svg.text: A denied effect never crosses the boundary; a denial changes no state, so it is never proposed
Recorded (ADR-0020: the replayable record includes actions attempted and denied): written
unordered, by the deciding replica, content reduced to digests (ADR-0004), and logged locally with
attribution.
Round open → the principal's round topic.
Round sealed → the round's after companion (ADR-0003 A2, confirmation-required C1): denials
only, same subject and round, erased with it; at most after_topic_limit records (dev: 64), then
one overflow marker.
Finding 11: the reference first dropped this clause; review caught it (ToO §15).
Neither the ordering authority (the Paxos log) nor the system of record (the archive, not built).
ADR-0005 is still Proposed; the K row is carried as a debt (ADR-0033 §2).
Kafka has no seal primitive: the mechanism refuses emission after the round ends and appends a
seal marker.
deny records
emissions,
Actuate records
An admit decided under epoch e can commit after a fence has moved the epoch on. The mechanism checks therefore run twice; the second run uses the state at the
entry's log position (ADR-0033 §4).
log / time
steps 1–6 pass under epoch e
operator fence_epoch: epoch → e+1
apply re-runs check_live: FencedEpoch
ordered, recorded, no effect

text.tspan: What the log orders: ordering is not authorization

svg.text: Subtractions need no quorum, but if they change replicated state they must be ordered, or replicas disagree about what is live (ADR-0033 §4; finding 3). Every Entry
kind in topak-core/src/state.rs:

text.tspan: at decide and at apply (ADR-0039 §1, §2; ADR-0041 §2)

svg.text: At decide, the lift computes live(o) for the seat's cell Observers: a live Observer lease, a heartbeat heard within T_obs on this replica's clock, and seq(t)
− mark(o, r) < K. Floor entry R3-observer-live forbids Actuate and Report under a Thinker without it, break-glass included.
At apply, only the deterministic half is re-checked: T_obs is a per-replica clock, so it cannot be (ToO §15, 2026.09.29 findings).
Consult is not coupled; an Observer's own heartbeats are not coupled. Values are placeholders (T_obs 5000 ms, K 8; floor/genesis-values.json).

text.tspan: The audit chain every effect carries (ToO §4.1; ADR-0015)

svg.text: effect → admit → floor ∧ bundle, at the lease's bundle revision → rules epoch → issuance → ADR-0025's intent axiom. No link is assumed except the last.
Each link is a field of the committed admit (below), which is forensic class F1 (ADR-0028).
The seat the session names
The lease's fence: the log index of its grant
The epoch the request carried
The admitted action with its target; for Actuate, the tool id, the inputs by digest, and whether the floor admitted it through
Digest of the frozen input both tiers evaluated (ADR-0030 §4)
Digest of the linked floor text
Digest of schema S
The permitting policy ids
The bundle revision that allowed: the lease's
Which bundle engine decided: sidecar or local WASM
Digest of the mechanism parameters; a mismatch at apply voids the admit
The deciding replica, which alone performs the effect
Under an attested session key (rungs 2 and 3), the guest's proof that it sent this action, checked again at apply (ADR-0034 §3.5; I41)

text.tspan: What this path does not show (ADR-0033 §1, §3, §6)

svg.text: Confinement: for an operator grant the MCP front door makes the alphabet the whole protocol, not the whole channel. The launcher (A7, pending) makes it
the whole channel for a guest it starts, at rung 1 on profiles that declare P3 fail, or at rung 3 only SIMULATED: no real principal is `Contained`.
A Byzantine replica: replicas are crash-recovery. The apply re-check stops stale admits, not forged ones; replica authentication is unbuilt (T-0045-1).
The reference is evidence, not the verified object: never promoted, in no TCB.
